Hon'Ble Dr. Justice Chillakur Sumalatha
 Oral Judgment
Sri. Gurudev Prasad K.T learned counsel for the appellant seeks permission to withdraw the appeal.
Memo to that effect is also filed.
NC: 2025:KHC:5929 Having considered the contents of the memo filed, the appellant is permitted to withdraw the appeal.
Thus, the appeal is dismissed as withdrawn.
Amount if any deposited by appellant be returned to the appellant on proper identification and according to the procedure established by law.
